---
title: "What is the maximum level flight speed at sea level?"
subtitle: "The user requested two questions exploring the performance of the reconstructed FT A-10 Warthog. We now determine its maximum level speed."
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 20.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 120.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 24.5      # s the probe actually used

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Stall speed from sibling entry
v_stall = 8.07  # m/s, from 2026-10-10-02-what-is-the-predicted-stall-speed-in-unaccelerated-level-flight

speed_data = compute_max_level_speed(airplane, mass_props)
v_max = speed_data["V_max"]
v_max_kmh = v_max * 3.6
v_max_mph = v_max * 2.23694
thrust_drag_n = speed_data["thrust_drag_max"]
alpha_max_deg = speed_data["alpha_max"]
cl_max = speed_data["cl_max"]
cd_max = speed_data["cd_max"]
rpm_max = speed_data["rpm_max"]
current_max = speed_data["current_max"]
p_elec_w = speed_data["p_elec_max"]
p_shaft_w = speed_data["p_shaft_max"]
speed_ratio = v_max / v_stall
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{v_max:.1f} m/s"`]{.hero-value}
[predicted maximum level flight speed at sea level]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** Under full throttle at sea level, the reconstructed Flite Test A-10 Warthog reaches a maximum level flight speed of [`{python} f"{v_max:.1f} m/s"`]{.key} ([`{python} f"{v_max_kmh:.1f} km/h"`]{.key}, [`{python} f"{v_max_mph:.1f} mph"`]{.key}).

At this airspeed, aerodynamic level drag equals available thrust at [`{python} f"{thrust_drag_n:.2f} N"`]{.key}, with the airframe trimmed at angle of attack $\alpha =$ [`{python} f"{alpha_max_deg:.2f}°"`]{.key} ($C_L =$ [`{python} f"{cl_max:.4f}"`]{.key}, $C_D =$ [`{python} f"{cd_max:.4f}"`]{.key}). The twin Power Pack C motors turn at [`{python} f"{rpm_max:.0f} RPM"`]{.key}, drawing [`{python} f"{current_max:.1f} A"`]{.key} ([`{python} f"{p_elec_w:.0f} W"`]{.key} total electrical power) from the 4S LiPo battery pack and delivering [`{python} f"{p_shaft_w:.0f} W"`]{.key} to the propeller shafts. Compared to the unaccelerated stall speed of [`{python} f"{v_stall:.1f} m/s"`]{.key} identified in [What is the predicted stall speed in unaccelerated level flight?](2026-10-10-02-what-is-the-predicted-stall-speed-in-unaccelerated-level-flight.qmd), this yields a maximum-to-stall speed ratio of [`{python} f"{speed_ratio:.2f}"`]{.key}.

(@fig-speed-thrust-drag) illustrates the balance between available thrust, level drag, and thrust power required across the flight envelope.

::: {.callout-note}
## New assumptions
1. **Propellers: Twin 9x4.5**, Power Pack C standard.
